card.name: Linking words in patient advice text
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "options", "including" or a comma, placed right after a noun like course, risk or medicines in patient-information text. It fires where a list or an "of" phrase is about to begin.

modes.label: "of" after a noun
modes.description: The word "of" follows a noun like course or risk and leads into a phrase about therapy or birth defects.
modes.example: it is common to feel better early in the course<< of>> therapy, the medication should be taken exactly

modes.label: List openers
modes.description: A comma or "including" begins a list of medicines or conditions to tell the provider about.
modes.example: your healthcare provider about all your medical conditions,<< including>> if you: have high or low blood

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: A noun or small word such as "options", "on" or "to" sits where a longer phrase follows.
modes.example: information on this website is intended to help educate patients about their treatment<< options>> and to facilitate a mutual or shared decision
